lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the gill slits, organized into roughly five vertical columns with four to five blobs per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary high-luminance blobs, creating a structured grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges traverse the upper flank, characterized by a sharp intensity gradient with highlights on the upper edges and shadows on the lower edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated high-luminance object is attached to the body wall ventrally, posterior to the right pectoral fin insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gills features a high-density population of micro-spots that are significantly smaller and less luminous than the lateral flank blobs.
